data.one_liner: Dart library implementing diff, match and patch algorithms for plain text.
data.what_it_does: Provides Myer's diff algorithm, a Bitap matching algorithm, and patch utilities to compare and synchronize plain text. It includes pre‑diff speedups and post‑diff cleanups for better performance and output quality.
use_when: You need to compute differences between two strings
You need to generate or apply text patches in a Dart or Flutter app
avoid_when: You require real‑time collaborative editing with conflict resolution
You need a full‑featured diff/merge UI component
weaknesses: Only works with plain text, not structured data
No built‑in UI components for displaying diffs
